caption: The drawing depicts a three-seat wooden bench with a natural wood tone throughout. The bench has three backrest sections, each formed by three horizontal slats, and each seat is divided by vertical supports. Both ends of the bench have armrests that curve outward and are supported by turned wooden spindles. The seat appears to be woven, possibly from cane, and is rectangular in shape. The legs are straight, with crossbars for structural support, and the overall design is symmetrical. The drawing has a light beige background and no other objects or decorations are present. The artist’s name, Arthur Johnson, is written at the bottom right corner.
title: Settee
